categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extent measurements, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal/regulatory framework creation, or other specialized administrative matters that would warrant a different classification.
